name: Oranjebtc S.A. - Educação e Investimento
summary: Oranjebtc SA - Educação e Investimento focuses on providing educational services, professional training, and strategic investment opportunities. Its pedagogical portfolio encompasses diverse courses, skill enhancement programs, expert consulting, and digital learning platforms. The company also oversees various preparatory programs and channels capital into strategically aligned or complementary ventures. Oranjebtc SA was founded by Guilherme Amado Cerqueira Gomes and Guilherme Affonso Ferreira Filho on February 27, 2025, and is officially headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
